fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: The normalized ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the log event occurred.
fields.justification: Provides the chronological anchor required for 3x02 correlation rules and time-sequence forensic timelines.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: The fully qualified domain name or short hostname of the asset that generated the event.
fields.justification: Enables 3x03 triage analyst grouping and asset scoping during targeted incident containment maneuvers.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: The specific log taxonomy or logging subsystem type identifier.
fields.justification: Allows 3x02 detection logic to accurately scale parsing context and isolate vendor-specific behaviors.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level classification of the event including authentication, process, file, network, or audit.
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

source_mapping.windows_json: Derived from channel and event_id via mapping table
source_mapping.linux_text: Derived from program or audit_type via mapping table

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized alert severity scale mapped universally to low, medium, high, or critical.
fields.justification: Acts as the principal sorting metric inside 3x03 triage queues to prioritize critical threats over informational logs.

source_mapping.windows_json: Derived from level or event_id mapping
source_mapping.linux_text: Derived from program severity level context
source_mapping.network_csv: Derived from alert action or priority score
source_mapping.network_json: Derived from alert.severity or priority fields

fields.name: user
fields.description: The account name or subject identity context linked directly to the log action.
fields.justification: Answers user tracking and behavioral analytics profiling questions during credential abuse hunting exercises.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: The runtime executable filename or file system location execution path path string.
fields.justification: Crucial for mapping malicious tools and detecting unauthorized code executions within 3x02 rule sets.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: The operating system kernel task identifier assigned to the running thread block process.
fields.justification: Provides the lineage hook to reconstruct execution tree maps during deep dive forensic root cause investigations.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: The origin source network address initiating connection streams or traffic requests.
fields.justification: Answers external network profiling questions and provides direct IOC indicators for blocking firewalls.

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: The network transmission source source allocation connection socket communication port.
fields.justification: Assists 3x03 analysis teams when tracking ephemeral connections and identifying active reverse shell activities.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: The destination address target receiving active protocol transmissions over network fabrics.
fields.justification: Maps asset egress directions to identify data exfiltration avenues and command-and-control connection paths.

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: The targeted endpoint listening communications tracking service socket port integer.
fields.justification: Isolates unexpected lateral network services like unauthorized SSH or RDP discovery attempts across network segments.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The enforcement decision, operation state result status, or log entry outcome token.
fields.justification: Allows 3x02 rules to distinguish successfully executed attacks from blocked or failed attempts.

source_mapping.windows_json: Derived from event_id audit outcome context
source_mapping.linux_text: Derived from parsed_fields.res or message context

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: The processing system ingestion tag path identifying input telemetry source ownership status.
fields.justification: Ensures full chain-of-custody tracking between default base evidence loops and added student inputs.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: The pristine string stream or unparsed complete event payload record.
fields.justification: Serves as a critical fallback option for triage teams to extract metadata fields not explicitly indexed.
